# TradingView Lightweight Charts

`lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js` is TradingView Lightweight Charts™ v4.2.3,
Copyright (c) TradingView, Inc., licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts

The application embeds this file as a C++ string (`OptionPricing/UI/LightweightChartsJs.inc`,
generated by `Tools/embed_chart_bundle.py`) and loads it into a Qt WebEngine view on the
Quotes tab. The TradingView attribution logo rendered by the library must remain visible.
